name: Military Ward
summary: In Ironforge, red banners gather the city's defenders in the Military Ward. Its halls, barracks, weapons masters, siege engines, and flying machines ready the mountain city's military.

sections.title: The Anvil of Dwarven Might
sections.body:
Along the northern edge of Ironforge, the Military Ward gathers the city's defenses. At its heart, the Hall of Arms holds warrior and hunter trainers and battlemasters. Nearby hangars house dwarven flying machines and steam tanks.

Drill squares and training dummies fill the ward, with supply shops close at hand. Craghelm's Plate and Chain, Goldfury's Hunting Supplies, and Timberline Arms serve those who train and defend the city. Mountaineers and city defenders gather here before setting out.

sections.title: A Garrison under Banners of War
sections.body:
Red banners cover the Military Ward, unlike the Commons' pale blue and the Great Forge's fiery orange. Soldiers drill and inspect their weapons, then gather with off-duty guards for ale at Bruuk's Corner.

Weapon Master Buliwyf Stonehand teaches recruits the ancient martial traditions of the dwarves.

faq.answer: Ironforge's dwarven army gathers in the Military Ward, alongside warrior and hunter trainers, weapons merchants, and siege machinery.

faq.q: Where can I train in weapons in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Weapon Master Buliwyf Stonehand teaches weapons at Timberline Arms in the Military Ward. There, Alliance fighters train with various armaments.

faq.q: What is kept inside the Hall of Arms?
aliases: what is in hall of arms
faq.answer: The Hall of Arms holds combat instructors and battlemasters. Large bays there house steam tanks and dwarven flying machines.

faq.q: Why are the banners red in this district?
faq.answer: Red banners mark the Military Ward as Ironforge's martial district. The city's districts use distinct heraldic colors for navigation and tradition.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can train in the Military Ward with warrior trainers and practice on its training dummies. Weapon masters can broaden your battlefield arsenal.
As a hunter, you can find beast masters and supplies in the Hall of Arms. Goldfury's Hunting Supplies has munitions and gear for rangers and mountaineers.
